title: Trusted protocol adapter interface
summary: The duck-typed Python role every LucHost adapter provides. protocol_id is required; capability_required_fields defaults to surface, capability_optional_fields defaults to input_schema/output_schema/canvas_operation. agent_visible defaults true, uses_package_files false. Methods marked optional may be absent; descriptive adapters need no invoke.

replaceability.why: The adapter and layering machinery are the Host foundation. If this machinery could be replaced by a creator layer, automatic fallback to the original could not be guaranteed. The Lucs carried by open protocols have their own replacement classes.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, self-Luc spec v0.3, 2026-10-18; interface charter rule 6, 2026-10-22

reach.notes: Trusted Host machinery, not authority granted to a Luc. Package calls remain bounded by their resolved permissions, Host APIs and editable scope.

operations.name: bind_host
operations.notes: Optional hook before insertion. No deadline or retry isolation; an exception prevents insertion. Concrete hooks may reject rebinding; this is not a closed error union.

operations.name: required_permissions

capability.description: A detached JSON capability mapping with id, protocol, description and adapter-owned fields; compile supplies input_schema and output_schema.

operations.notes: Optional method returns a Python frozenset, represented here as unique names. Otherwise Host uses adapter.permissions or the empty set. Plain ValueError may escape; no deadline.

operations.name: granted_permissions

capability.description: A detached JSON capability mapping with id, protocol, description and adapter-owned fields; compile supplies input_schema and output_schema.

operations.notes: Optional hook returns a set of names that must be in permissions_granted, even without an API. Absent hook adds no check. No deadline.

operations.name: compile

capability.description: A detached JSON capability mapping with id, protocol, description and adapter-owned fields; compile supplies input_schema and output_schema.

output.description: A detached JSON capability mapping with id, protocol, description and adapter-owned fields; compile supplies input_schema and output_schema.

operations.notes: Required unless compile_package exists. Returns capability with input_schema/output_schema. Direct compile ValueError is not wrapped. Known concrete codes listed here are examples rather than a closed union of adapters; see concrete adapter interfaces. No deadline.

operations.name: compile_package

capability.description: A detached JSON capability mapping with id, protocol, description and adapter-owned fields; compile supplies input_schema and output_schema.

files.description: Mapping[str, bytes] of verified resolved package resources.

output.description: A detached JSON capability mapping with id, protocol, description and adapter-owned fields; compile supplies input_schema and output_schema.

operations.notes: Optional instead of compile. Must return the capability plus schemas. ValueError becomes E_LUC_CAPABILITY_INVALID in Host.load; LucError keeps its code. No deadline. Listed concrete codes are not a closed adapter union.

operations.name: validate_authority

capability.description: A detached JSON capability mapping with id, protocol, description and adapter-owned fields; compile supplies input_schema and output_schema.

resolution.description: Python APIResolution from iface:luc.host-api/v1, carrying requested and effective authority.

operations.notes: Optional. Direct hook codes below come from concrete adapters. Host.load catches every ValueError, including LucError subclasses, and replaces its code with E_LUC_ADAPTER_AUTHORITY. Does not grant authority; no deadline.

operations.name: descriptor_output_schema

capability.description: A detached JSON capability mapping with id, protocol, description and adapter-owned fields; compile supplies input_schema and output_schema.

operations.notes: Required. Interaction descriptors also permit the mounted receipt; post-invoke validation still uses capability.output_schema. No deadline.

operations.name: capability_effect

capability.description: A detached JSON capability mapping with id, protocol, description and adapter-owned fields; compile supplies input_schema and output_schema.

anyOf.description: Effect metadata including kind, preview, apply, writes_project, apply_fields and optional edits.

operations.notes: Optional; a truthy mapping marks descriptor WRITE, MEDIUM risk and blocked plan mode. None uses canvas_operation or interaction_only. No deadline.

operations.name: describe_capability

capability.description: A detached JSON capability mapping with id, protocol, description and adapter-owned fields; compile supplies input_schema and output_schema.

output.description: A detached JSON capability mapping with id, protocol, description and adapter-owned fields; compile supplies input_schema and output_schema.

operations.notes: Optional, returns a public capability mapping; Host bounds/detaches the final result with json_value. No deadline.

operations.name: describe_for_context

capability.description: A detached JSON capability mapping with id, protocol, description and adapter-owned fields; compile supplies input_schema and output_schema.

output.description: A detached JSON capability mapping with id, protocol, description and adapter-owned fields; compile supplies input_schema and output_schema.

operations.notes: Optional and called only with a non-None context. Adapter may add contextual renderer data. No deadline.

operations.name: invoke

capability.description: A detached JSON capability mapping with id, protocol, description and adapter-owned fields; compile supplies input_schema and output_schema.

output.description: Adapter result, possibly a ToolResult with a .model member; descriptive adapters may omit this method.

operations.notes: No generic deadline or idempotency at this seam. Concrete adapter contracts specify their refusals; invoke can propagate LucError, ToolRefused or native exceptions. Listed codes are shared/packaged examples, not a closed union of all adapters.

operations.name: validate_result

capability.description: A detached JSON capability mapping with id, protocol, description and adapter-owned fields; compile supplies input_schema and output_schema.

operations.notes: Optional. Otherwise Host validates with its bounded JSON validator (E_LUC). Native/packaged hooks use jsonschema directly and can raise ValidationError without a LucError code. No deadline.

operations.name: runtime_available
operations.notes: Optional bootstrap probe. False makes the package unavailable as E_LUC_ADAPTER_RUNTIME; absence means no availability probe. No deadline.

invariants.text: A manifest cannot register an adapter; only Host code supplies adapter instances.

break: The operation rejects invalid input, integrity, authority or binding state as described by its operation.

conformance.notes: Existing tests listed here were inspected, not run for this documentation task. The area checker validates the contract files; it does not exercise runtime behavior.

known_deviations.text: There is no formal Python Protocol or closed adapter error union. ValueError handling differs between compile and compile_package; custom validation hooks may raise non-Luc exceptions.
Authority-hook LucError codes are overwritten because LucError is a ValueError and this catch has no separate LucError branch.

open_questions.text: Should a future executable adapter conformance check require one uniform exception envelope and pure compilation?
